description: Configure VSCode for offline work by modifying settings. Open Settings (File → Preferences → Settings or Ctrl+,) and configure the following: 1) Set 'update.mode' to 'none' to disable update checks, 2) Set 'telemetry.telemetryLevel' to 'off' to disable telemetry, 3) Set 'extensions.autoUpdate' to false (unchecked) to disable extension auto-updates, 4) Set 'git.autofetch' to false (unchecked) to disable automatic git fetches, 5) Set 'files.autoSave' to 'afterDelay' to enable auto-save, 6) Set 'files.autoSaveDelay' to 500 or any value ≤ 1000 milliseconds for aggressive auto-save. You can modify these settings either through the Settings UI by searching for each setting name, or by directly editing settings.json (click the {} icon in Settings UI or use Ctrl+Shift+P → 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)'). Settings can be configured in either User settings or Workspace settings.
